231: On a holiday, making eruvs for yards and conjoining alleys are unnecessary, but techum eruvs are necessary. All of the laws of techum were explained in the section on laws for techum eruvs.

If a holiday falls on Friday, we do not make either yard or techum eruvs (even if one made an eruv tavshilin) (Ra"n chapter 2 of Beitzah). However, if one realized on the first day of a two day holiday in the Diaspora [that he didn't make an eruv], he can make an yard eruv on condition [see previous chapter paragraph 22]. However, we do not make techum eruvs on a holiday.
